title: Design system and frontend: agent skills for TYPO3
header: Design system and frontend in 100 seconds
description: Design tokens become Fluid content elements, the site gets a living style guide, and assets and icons are built the v14 way. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 100 seconds: Design system and frontend, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-shadcn-content-elements, typo3-design-system-page, typo3-vite, typo3-icon14). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: A design system only helps when it reaches the content elements.
Design system and frontend: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Turns shadcn/ui presets into Fluid content elements with semantic tokens, previews and seed data.
Switch the preset, switch to dark mode: every element follows.
Builds an accessible design-system page in your site, with design.md, tokens.json and a one-page PDF.
It asks which installation and which page to use before it writes, so nothing lands on a site you did not choose.
Sets up Vite 7 for TYPO3 sitepackages, with an entry per content element.
TYPO3 v14 removed the core’s own concatenation and compression of frontend assets, so a build tool now does that work.
Redraws and migrates extension icons to the v14 line style, for light and dark mode.
Heavy, filled icons look foreign next to the v14 core, and a module icon that vanishes in dark mode is a bug.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
